warnings.message: Same full target sentence is reused across multiple scored activities.

manualReview.scope: Model/editor Product Quality v2 naturalness polish of EN-A1-L-0082; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Character prompts and English distractors were re-read as complete learner-facing utterances; teacher directives and known ungrammatical generated distractors were removed.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: خانواده directly matches the bounded family sense in both turns.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: One concrete noun target is practiced in two familiar be-patterns.

distractorQuality.evidence: Wrong English options are grammatical/natural alternatives that differ on meaning, action, referent, quantity, polarity or context instead of using broken substitutions.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Character turns now ask or react in ways that pragmatically license the learner response rather than instructing the learner to repeat a line.

difficultyFit.evidence: Utterances are short and early-A1 appropriate.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: family repeats across listening, recognition, transfer and hidden retrieval.

transferQuality.evidence: The learner moves from identifying family in a photo to stating presence.

overallCoherence.evidence: Scenario, turns and tasks align with the same bounded outcome.

learnerExperience.evidence: No real learner test is claimed; engagement and perceived difficulty remain unverified.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
